qualification.package: Public 0.20.0 wheel; immutable native and pipeline images import the exact package. Source CI and bilingual Pages passed.
qualification.engine: On one RTX PRO 6000 with resident FP8 weights, 44/6 and 42/8 completed three matched five-second I2VA inputs under both Sage INT8 QK / FP8 PV and FROST BF16 dense / FP16 sparse PV. The portrait case also completed six-step audio refinement with the selected partition. See 0.17.0 release notes for complete-engine times and scope.
qualification.quality_scope: Native detail and temporal crops support per-scene observations; visual quality and action adherence are evaluated against the input brief and reference. The default remains 40/10. Hardware capacity and application rollout retain their separate qualification.
qualification.reference_audio: Single SM89 48 GiB BF16 ring and SM120 Server 96 GiB resident FP8; five-second full/pooled reference video through 1344x768, owned audio cache and decode overlap. Scope and matched decoded-media evidence: reference/releases#_0-18-0.
qualification.audio_quality: Matched 6/12/20-step audio on single RTX 4090 48 GiB BF16 ring and rented RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server resident FP8. Complete-call latency, approximate cache choices and listening limits: reference/releases#_0-19-0.
qualification.audio_weight_cache: Single RTX 4090 48 GiB, BF16 ring, twelve-step five-second I2VA with hidden reuse and decode overlap. Four matched complete pairs save 8.93–11.06 seconds with identical decoded video and PCM; the owned native implementation completed four additional calls. See reference/releases#_0-20-0.
